correctness.rationale: Eleven pairwise disjoint rotation cycles give an exhaustive 3^8 candidate universe for any cardinality-11 decycling set. A standalone deterministic program enumerates all 6561 transversals, tests DAGness by Kahn elimination, independently tests 21 length-2/4 simple cycle masks, reconstructs longest residual paths, and verifies 84 survivors split 60/24. Six alphabet permutations and reversal produce seven complete size-12 orbits. Direct enumeration of every ternary length-8/9/10 word confirms exact hitting thresholds. The code is included and has been executed successfully; no extrapolation beyond the finite domain is asserted.

originality.rationale: The closest full primary article establishes the minimum-decycling-set framework, the necklace/PCR necessary condition and general exploration algorithms, but its exact-count table concerns the binary alphabet and its path-length table concerns binary and four-letter alphabets; it does not present the ternary length-three 84-set census, 60/24 sharp guarantee profile, seven symmetry classes or sufficiency of 21 short-cycle constraints among cardinality-minimal transversals. Earlier general UHS/remaining-path bounds also do not imply these exact counts. Multiple targeted statement and reduction searches identified no exact equivalent, but unindexed computations remain a residual originality risk.
residual_risks: A ternary three-mer instance may already have been enumerated in unindexed software, a dataset or a secondary work without explicit publication.
This is a small but natural exact classification, not a general asymptotic theorem; its value depends on the sharp finite window benchmark and complete symmetry/obstruction structure.

value.rationale: Minimum-cardinality decycling sets are a well-motivated optimal-footprint support family for context-free sequence sketching. The complete first three-letter ternary classification supplies an exact optimal guaranteed-hit word length, counts all equivalent and inequivalent choices, and proves a compact 21-short-cycle obstruction criterion for any equality-size candidate. Neither existence from standard constructions nor generic parameter algorithms provide this classified exact benchmark without the nontrivial exhaustive comparison.
